messages:
mari-support: Customer reports a gift-code credit being applied twice after redeeming in-app. Account acct-4428 shows +$50 twice and invoice INV-889 shows a $100 net credit. Can billing or eng take a look?

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BL-12347 and linked to this thread.

kevin-billing: Thanks @mari-support — can you paste the exact redemption payload (timestamp, redemption_id) and any gateway webhook IDs? Also whether the customer pressed redeem multiple times or saw an error then retried.

mari-support: Paste from support notes:
```
user: acct-4428
code: WELCOME50
redeemed_at: 2025-11-03T14:02:12Z
redemption_id: rdm_8f71c
ui_action: clicked redeem -> success toast shown
customer says they only clicked once
```
We also have a second ledger entry a second later: 2025-11-03T14:02:13Z, ledger_id ledg_91a2c. No gateway webhook recorded (this was an internal promo).

dan-engineering: Interesting — two ledger rows one second apart suggests an internal double-apply, likely from a retry path. Can you run a quick query for billing_events for that acct and code? Example SQL I use:
```
SELECT id, event_type, meta, created_at
FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct-4428'
AND meta->>'code' = 'WELCOME50'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

mari-support: Ran the query, snippet: 
```
id: ledg_91a2c | event_type: credit_applied | meta: {"code":"WELCOME50","source":"promo-service","redemption_id":"rdm_8f71c"} | created_at: 2025-11-03T14:02:13Z
id: ledg_89b4f | event_type: credit_applied | meta: {"code":"WELCOME50","source":"promo-service","redemption_id":"rdm_8f71c"} | created_at: 2025-11-03T14:02:12Z
```
both rows have same redemption_id.

kevin-billing: Same redemption_id on both entries is key — that should have been deduped. Either our idempotency lookup failed or the promo-service applied credits without honoring the idempotency key. I will check ledger reconciliation to see how invoice INV-889 was computed.

dan-engineering: Quick theory: promo-service calls apply_credit job and then enqueues a confirmation job. If the confirmation job retries and the apply_credit path doesn't re-check dedupe by redemption_id, it can double-write. I’ll look at the job code paths.

mari-support: Customer is getting upset; they see balance +$100 and invoice shows negative charge. They only did the one action. Any ETA on rollback?

kevin-billing: I can create a reversing journal entry to neutralize the duplicate ledger row today — I need approval from finance for manual journal, but it's a standard reversal. I’ll hold off until eng confirms root cause so we don't flip-flop.

dan-engineering: Found the bug in promo-service handler: we check idempotency in the HTTP layer but the background worker path calls apply_credit without idempotency guard. Proposed patch: add upsert by (redemption_id) in apply_credit and return existing ledger id if present. Patch ready, running unit tests. Will push hotfix to staging in ~30m.

kevin-billing: Sounds good. Once fix is in, please send me the ledger ids to revert (if still present). I’ll prepare the reversal entry and note BL-12347.

mari-support: Quick repro steps for internal QA we used:
1) POST /redeem with body {"account_id":"acct-4428","code":"WELCOME50","redemption_id":"rdm-REPRO-1"}
2) Simulate background worker duplicate run: run job apply_credit twice with same payload
Expect: single ledger row. Current: two rows.

dan-engineering: Thanks — reproduced locally. Hotfix merged to staging, deploying now. Also adding a lightweight DB unique constraint on (account_id, redemption_id, code) for safety — will coordinate with ops for migration window.

kevin-billing: After hotfix, I’ll reconcile INV-889 and issue a correcting journal if needed. We should also notify the customer and remove duplicate credit from their current balance before their next invoice calculation.

mari-support: Notifying customer now: brief note that we identified a duplicate credit, we’re reverting and will confirm when done.

billing-bot: BL-12347 updated: status -> investigation, assignees: kevin-billing, dan-engineering.

kevin-billing: I reverted the duplicate ledger entry in a pending journal (to be posted after ops migration). Balance preview now shows original +$50. I will post the journal after migration completes.

dan-engineering: Migration scheduled in 2 hours, safe to post. After deploy and migration, I’ll run a sweep to detect other redemption_ids with >1 credit and send a report.

mari-support: Customer notified and appreciates the quick turnaround :thumbsup:. Closing loop once reversal is posted.

kevin-billing: Will update BL-12347 with final journal id when posted.

dan-engineering: Follow-up action items: 1) add DB constraint (ops) 2) add idempotency guard in worker (merged) 3) sweep script to find duplicates (in progress).

mari-support: Thanks all.
